fusions.name: Fetched Stick
fusions.desc: Throws a stick that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill brings one back.

fusions.name: Held at Bay
fusions.desc: Rushes every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 11 damage, stunning them for 0.8 seconds and leaving them [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Kennel in the Buttress
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier of buttress roots that absorbs the next 18 damage, up to 4 blows, for 6 seconds. A hound escort guards you for 9 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Buried Bones
fusions.desc: Every kill you make buries a stack at your roots, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you heal for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
